findings.identity_explanation: Tag LIFT-01 matches exactly in CR:LIFT-01, ES:LIFT-01, FM:TFM-0301, COM-08, WAR-08 and OM-07. Model VX-1600, serial VX16-7101 and location Core A agree wherever stated; no possible tag matches were raised.

exceptions.finding: The COM-08 field for LIFT-01 says Final approval: Signed, but an Arabic remark on the same certificate says LIFT-01 was tested but the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued. Under Evidence 2.1 a remark cannot override a field, so both are reported as a conflict. LIFT-01 is a life-safety asset, so this is critical and no source settles it.

exceptions.next_action: Ask Halvorn Contracting to confirm in writing whether the final consultant signature for LIFT-01 has been issued, and to supply the signed certificate if it has. The FM handover manager and FM operations manager decide how to treat the approval until then.

findings.summary: The rule check passed all six items for LIFT-01, and I opened COM-08 and WAR-08 myself. COM-08 gives conflicting evidence: the LIFT-01 line says Final approval: Signed, but an Arabic remark says the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued. LIFT-01 is a life-safety lift, so I am not recommending Ready for review and I am escalating.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager, with the FM operations manager consulted (life-safety asset)
findings.escalation_reason: Escalation 2.1 and 2.3: LIFT-01 is a life-safety asset with an open exception, and COM-08 contradicts itself on final approval with no other source to settle it. They must decide whether the Signed field can be relied on and whether to request written confirmation or the signed certificate before the acceptance review.
findings.clarification_subject: LIFT-01 (Sarava Tower): confirm final approval on commissioning certificate COM-08
findings.clarification_body:
Dear Halvorn Contracting project manager,

Commissioning certificate COM-08 from Vertica Lifts lists LIFT-01 (VX-1600, serial VX16-7101, Core A) with Result: Pass and Final approval: Signed. However, an Arabic remark on the same certificate states that LIFT-01 was tested but the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued.

Please confirm in writing whether the consultant's final signature for LIFT-01 has been issued. If it has, please send the signed certificate. If it has not, please send the corrected certificate once signed. A promise that it will follow cannot be treated as the certificate.

This request is a draft for approval by the FM handover manager.

Regards,
Tessmar Facility Services
uncertainties: Whether the consultant's final signature on COM-08 for LIFT-01 has actually been issued; the document does not show who signed or when.
The Arabic remark is a translation read by the assistant; a person should confirm its meaning.
